description: Replacement of existing timber windows with new double glazed timber windows, to the front elevation; formation of a new window opening and installation of a double glazed uPVC window, and replacement of an existing timber window with a new double glazed uPVC window to the side elevation; replacement of an existing timber window with a new double glazed uPVC window, and replacement of existing timber French door with a new double glazed uPVC sliding door to the rear elevation at lower ground floor level.
